title: Coordinate restriction and coordinate dependence
statement: Let $f$ be a real-valued function on $Omega^n$ that depends only on the coordinates in a finite set $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. For any coordinate $i$ and value $\omega\in\Omega$, the function obtained by replacing coordinate $i$ of each input by $\omega$ depends only on the coordinates in $S\setminus\{i\}$.
